Friendly tidy intact fantasy village, welcoming Halloween crafts, no dark red/black horror, no blood or decay. Detailed materials and outer neighborhood life without cluttering the fighting floor. No text, letters, numbers, signage text, HUD, UI panels, borders, watermark, characters, people, monsters, bosses, active lamps, beacons, magic circles, loot chests, gameplay objectives or interactive furniture. Static outside architectural motifs are okay; flat paving motifs are decorations only. Output a finished full original image, not a contact sheet or mockup.

FLOOR: a large very subtle concentric oval ring street built out of tiny radial cream pavers, centered in the open flat plaza, with an elegant three-petal mosaic formed by paving not an object, small gray and pale honey tesserae. Entire ring and center remain flush solid dry walkable floor, no raised stage or circular wall. Visibly rounded festive civic-plaza composition, tiny paving scale.
